## What
Perf sweep 2026-10-07, card 2. `open-pr` now refuses a RISKY code PR unless a pre-PR review receipt exists for the exact head tree.

**This PR changes a gate. It needs human review.**

## Risk rule (report thresholds)
Gated when ANY of: lines > 264, subsystems > 2, files > 5, no prepared card in the diff, or builder is an operator agent (no `WE_CONVEYOR_WORKER=1`). Card-only PRs and small prepared conveyor PRs are untouched.

## Knob
`prePrReview.mode` off|advise|enforce in `scripts/pre-pr-review-settings.json` (read from the WE root, not the lane). Built-in/product default: `advise`. This repo: `enforce`.

## Receipt
`node scripts/converge-cli.mjs receipt --lane=<lane> --state=<file>` stamps `<git-dir>/pre-pr-review-receipt.json` with the head tree hash, only after a converge run ended in `land` and with a clean tracked tree. Any later edit voids it. Bypass is operator-only: `--skipPrePrReview=<reason> --actor=<name> --operatorInstruction="<quoted operator instruction>"`. A dispatched worker (`WE_CONVEYOR_WORKER=1`) can never bypass; a bypass without an instruction is refused. Every bypass is recorded in the PR body, `<git-dir>/pre-pr-review-bypass.log`, and `.operations/pre-pr-bypass/<day>.jsonl` (countable; the coroner hook is a follow-up).

## Not weakened
Added before `pr-land`; the post-PR review gate and verify finish-guard are untouched. Dry-run is not gated.

## Proof
- New tests fail on old `open-pr-io.mjs`/`converge-cli.mjs` (3 red), pass on new.
- Replay with real PR file lists: #4017 (2269 lines, 8 subsystems, 23 files) and #3990 (1209/5/29) refused with no receipt, admitted with one; a card-only PR passes untouched.
- Brief step 6 updated (run converge alongside verify, stamp receipt).
- Not done: coroner attribute (follow-up). This PR itself opened with a recorded bypass, since its panel is the human review.
